{{Quote|They’re hailing us.|Unidentified Duros to Voyce Evlen|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who served as a [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] aboard the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] corvette ''[[Starhook]]'' under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voyce Evlen]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the ''Starhook'' was sent by corrupt Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] to meet with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] vessel ''[[Concussor]]'', which, by then, was commandeered by [[Bhindi Drayson]]'s unit of [[Wraith Squadron]].<ref name="MK" />
